types.title: Ticket types
types.empty_body: Add one so people can choose how they take part. Without ticket types the event uses a simple RSVP.

field.name: Name
field.access_code_hint: People need this code to see and claim this ticket type.
field.access_code_set: A code is already set. Type a new one to replace it.
field.waitlist_hint: Let people join a waitlist once this type is full.

delete.title: Delete this ticket type?
delete.body: {{name}} will be removed from the signup page.
delete.banner: A ticket type with registrations cannot be deleted. Close its sales instead.
delete.in_use: People have already registered for this type. Close its sales instead of deleting it.

questions.title: Registration questions
questions.hint: Answers are visible only to hosts with permission, and are removed 30 days after the event.
questions.archive_note: Removing a question archives it. Answers already given are kept.
questions.ticket_scope_hint: A question limited to one ticket type is asked only when someone picks that type — so it is never asked if every type is hidden. Leave it on every ticket type to always ask it.
